description:
NFT Owner Lookup: Ethereum mainnet ERC-721 owner of any token ID. Lists the NFT token ids an address holds in one ERC-721 collection on Ethereum mainnet, read from chain state at the latest block.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_erc721_tokens_of. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_tokens_of
